A_superseded.name: A
A_superseded.note: NEAT from a cloned teacher network (24 hidden), six stages: calm, steady push, gusts, turbulence, boulder, polish. Training wheels fade in stages 2-4.

stages.name: calm
stages.expect: Quick: the cloned network already lands in calm air; NEAT polishes centring. Pass within ~30 generations.

stages.name: steady push
stages.expect: The drift sensor should let it lean into a constant push. Risk: landing off the pad downwind.

stages.name: gusts
stages.expect: Real gusts at full strength. The wind project's best NEAT reached ~91% with turbulence; aim 95% without.

stages.name: gusts + turbulence
stages.expect: The full wind task. Beat the earlier 91%.

stages.name: boulder
stages.expect: The new obstacle. The teacher's boulder rule was cloned in, so it starts above zero; expect the longest stage.

stages.name: polish
stages.expect: Everything on, only the env score + landing bonus. Pass = 98% on 100 + 100 fresh flights, then the 1,000-flight goal check.

B.name: B
B.note: Attempt B = A with two fixes: the steady push now follows the wind ramp (in A it was always full strength), and training wheels start at 0.3, not 1.0 (the pilot landed 83% with full wheels, 84% without, 89.5% at 0.3). Steady-push pass lowered to 90%: a constant push up to 15 is harder than real gusts (the pilot: 84%).

C.name: C
C.note: Attempt C = B resumed from its population at gen ~412 (in the gusts + turbulence stage), with one change: the boulder stage ramps the boulder size from 40% to 100%. Why: the cloned start network only landed 25% with the boulder (pilot 77%) and B's best wind champion 14% (300 paired flights): the boulder skill was never cloned well, so it must be learned in NEAT, from small boulders up.

D.name: D
D.note: Attempt D: restart forced by a bug. Runs A-C started from a broken copy of the pilot: NEAT's tanh output squashed the cloned scores to ties, so 1 step in 9 took the wrong action (the copy landed 43% in wind instead of 92%). Fixed (identity outputs, test). Restarting, so three more changes ride along: the 15-input clone (+2 route sensors), seed noise 0.02 and weight mutation power 0.05 (the boulder skill is fragile: noise 0.05 cost ~10 points), and 30% boulder flights mixed into stages 1-4 so selection keeps protecting the boulder skill (forgotten twice before). The exact start network: 98% wind, 77% boulder (60 flights each).

stages.name: calm
stages.expect: Pass at once: the exact copy of the pilot lands nearly every calm flight.

stages.name: steady push
stages.expect: Lean into a constant push that grows from 5 to 15. The pilot lands ~84-90% here, so pass at 90%. Risk: landing off the pad downwind.

stages.name: gusts
stages.expect: Real gusts at full strength. The wind project's best NEAT reached ~91% with turbulence; aim 95% without.

stages.name: gusts + turbulence
stages.expect: Full wind. The start network already lands ~98% here (60 flights); keep it while turbulence ramps up.

stages.name: boulder
stages.expect: The start network already lands ~77% with full boulders. Ramp 60% -> 100% size; pass at 95% with no hits.

stages.name: polish
stages.expect: Everything on, only the env score + landing bonus. Pass = 98% on 100 + 100 fresh flights, then the 1,000-flight goal check.

E.name: E
E.note: Attempt E: the curriculum rebuilt around what the network can't do yet. Run D showed the easy stages destroy skill the exact copy already has (full wind: 90% at gen 0, 79% after calm air, 52% after the steady push; boulder 71% -> 38%), because selection only sees the easy world. So: start from the exact copy, train the weakness (the boulder) from calm air up to full wind, and fly 40% of every stage's training flights in the full final world (rehearsal) so nothing is forgotten.

stages.name: boulder, calm air
stages.expect: The pilot lands 95.6% here. The copy should get there; selection now sees the boulder in every flight.

stages.name: boulder, gusts
stages.expect: Steering around the boulder while gusts push sideways. Pass at 93%.

stages.name: everything
stages.expect: The full final world. Start level with the pilot (~71-77%); aim to pass it.

stages.name: polish
stages.expect: Everything on, only the env score + landing bonus. Pass = 98% on 100 + 100 fresh flights, then the 1,000-flight goal check.

F.name: F
F.note: Attempt F = E resumed at the start of stage 2 (gen ~152), with one change: 20 training flights per network instead of 10, and the top 8 re-flown on 60 instead of 40. Why: in the real task E's champions did not pass the pilot and drifted down (gen 75: 76.2%, gen 140: 70.0%, pilot 76.8%, 400 paired flights) while their stage-world checks rose: selection on 10 flights (4 of them real) is mostly luck.

G.name: G
G.note: Attempt G = F resumed, with one change, approved by the user: a fairer boulder. Its top now stays at least 3.5 m below the start (centre 3 m above the pad up to 6.5 m minus its radius; it was up to 7 m). Before, about 2% of flights put the rock right under the start and looked unavoidable (a crude escape still hit 2.1%; now 0.65%). Lower boulders crowd the pad more: the pilot lands 71.7% on the new layout. All real-task numbers from here on are on the new layout.

H.name: H
H.note: Attempt H: a new start. The pilot v2 (clean wind sensor, edge clamp, early brake, tuned on the corrected final task) cloned into a 16-24-4 network. Same curriculum as F (boulder in calm air -> in gusts -> everything -> polish, 40% real-task rehearsal, 20 flights per network), with one rule change: a stage passes with <= 2% boulder hits on the check (zero hits blocked checks of 96-98% landed).

I.name: I
I.note: Attempt I: start from the pilot-v2 clone (84.8% real task) and train ONLY on the real task. Why: in H the real-task result fell from 83% (gen 0) to 58-61% by gen 25 in the 'boulder, calm air' stage, despite 40% rehearsal; the clone leans on the clean wind sensor, which reads ~0 in calm air, so those weights drift. Same lesson as B-D: with an expert start, any world but the real one erodes skill. 24 flights per network, re-fly top 8 on 60.

stages.name: real task
stages.expect: Hold the clone's ~85% and push the remaining failures (boulder hits, off-pad, crashes, ~4-5% each) down. Pass = 98% on 100 + 100 fresh flights, then the 1,000-flight goal check.

J.name: J
J.note: Attempt J = I with one change: the fitness rewards landing, not points. In I the champion's game score rose (182 -> 210-220) while its real-task landing rate fell (85% -> ~72% on 100 fresh flights): the score pays for fuel economy and the centre bonus, a trap. Now: +300 for landing between the flags, no centre bonus, game score x 0.3 as a tie-breaker, -100 extra for a boulder hit, -200 for a timeout. Fresh from the pilot-v2 clone.

stages.name: real task
stages.expect: Selection now pays for landings. Expect the real-task line to hold at ~85% and then climb; if it still drifts down, the next suspect is mutation noise.
